decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 into a cyclical precast concrete market, the combined robot's value is still highly uncertain, and keeping it listed costs little because it shares components with the separate shuttering and de-shuttering robots.
One year of website presence reveals too little about demand, and keeping this modular de-shuttering robot open is cheap while uncertainty resolves.
The profile storage robot is a low-cost complementary option for automated precast lines, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The shuttering robot is core to the firm's automation portfolio and too new for its results to justify abandoning it, so the option is kept open.
